video_title: NBA Draft Prospects on Black Fatherhood | 2026 NBA Draft Preview | Andscape

quotes.speaker: Carlos Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Changing perceptions of Black fathers in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: Traditionally, they like to paint it in a negative light, but lately that's shifted.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: What do you think the perception has been about Black fathers?

text_blocks.speaker: Carlos Boozer
text_blocks.text: Traditionally, they like to paint it in a negative light, but lately that's shifted. You see a lot more Black fathers standing up with their sons or standing up with their daughters and being there, showing up, shining light on the positive impact so that we can inspire the next generation of fathers.

quotes.speaker: Dee Flemings
quotes.summary_phrase: Dee Flemings on being a present Black father
quotes.excerpt: I'm a present Black father and I want them to see that.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: What do you think the perception has been about Black fathers?

text_blocks.speaker: Dee Flemings
text_blocks.text: There's the age-old stereotype that we're not present, so I think that was something that like I'm always going to be here. I'm a firefighter, my wife's a nurse, so like community is really important to us. I'm a present Black father and I want them to see that.

quotes.speaker: Carlos Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Carlos Boozer on his tough love coaching style
quotes.excerpt: I always told him if we're going to do this, we're going to do it the right way.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: Were you tough love with your son in basketball?

text_blocks.speaker: Carlos Boozer
text_blocks.text: Always. Always. It was me just introducing him to the game and I always told him if we're going to do this, we're going to do it the right way. There's not going to be any shortcuts or anything, so I was always tough on him for sure.

quotes.speaker: Carlos Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Carlos Boozer on Cam Boozer's early potential
quotes.excerpt: I knew that this one was really special probably around like sixth grade.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: At what point did you say, when I'm seeing is something that could be on the highest level?

text_blocks.speaker: Carlos Boozer
text_blocks.text: I knew that this one was really special probably around like sixth grade. We had him with different trainers that were really good with developing skill sets in the backyard, and he was picking it up faster than everybody else. And then I think the light bulb went off like seventh, eighth grade and he just took off from there.

quotes.speaker: Carlos Boozer
quotes.summary_phrase: Cam Boozer's leadership and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He doesn't cheat the game. He shows that every single day.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: What separates Cam from everyone else in the draft?

text_blocks.speaker: Carlos Boozer
text_blocks.text: He's a guy that the rest of the team will galvanize around because he doesn't cheat the game. He shows that every single day, he studies the game, he puts the work into it every single day. He's as dedicated as you're ever going to find a player to his craft. And so because of that, the team will always follow him, because he's the natural leader.

quotes.speaker: Dee Flemings
quotes.summary_phrase: Dee Flemings on his son's draft journey
quotes.excerpt: That'd be a great culmination to everything we've done.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: When you notice that Father's Day was two days before the draft, what came to mind?

text_blocks.speaker: Dee Flemings
text_blocks.text: That'd be a great culmination to everything we've done. Look, we've been doing this since, like I say, three or four. Like he finally reached this goal, this was always his goal. And so to see him achieve that and know that I was able to actually help him achieve that, like I did my job.

quotes.speaker: Dee Flemings
quotes.summary_phrase: Dee Flemings on raising a good human
quotes.excerpt: It costs you nothing to be a good person, but it can cost you everything if you're not.

text_blocks.speaker: Marc J. Spears
text_blocks.text: What life lessons stick with you daily that he's bestowed on you?

text_blocks.speaker: Dee Flemings
text_blocks.text: One of my favorite sayings: it costs you nothing to be a good person, but it can cost you everything if you're not. Be a good dude, stand up dude, honest dude, and everything else will take care of itself because you're going to be a professional at life longer than you're going to be at the game of basketball.
